hardware_label: Measured on 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13420H (laptop-full); not a Raspberry Pi, not embedded hardware

verdicts.question: What does preprocessing alone cost per frame?
verdicts.statement: Preprocessing (invalid-point removal, range filter, voxel downsample) takes a median 143 ms (P95 186 ms); the voxel stage alone is 133 ms. That already exceeds the deadline before any registration. Non-consecutive frames: no odometry or accuracy claim.
verdicts.rule: fail if the median preprocessing latency exceeds the deadline
